name: Nihonium
summary: Nihonium is a synthetic chemical element; it has symbol Nh and atomic number 113. It is extremely radioactive: its most stable known isotope, nihonium-286, has a half-life of about 10 seconds. In the periodic table, nihonium is a transactinide element in the p-block. It is a member of period 7 and group 13.

properties.discovery: Riken (Japan, first undisputed claim 2004)JINR (Russia) and Livermore (US, first announcement 2003)
